searchText: We only bump minor number after mainnet is upgraded. And somehow decided replace "rc" with "beta" in this cycle 😅 If I sync a CL on a post-Dencun network, will it persist all the recent blobs to disk as part of the sync, or only grab them from the network if "requested" in some way? Could be wrong, but I'd expect it to sync them all "automatically" since a block within the retention period shouldn't be considered as a valid fork choice target unless the node actually has any blobs that go with it. It may not download blobs from orphaned blocks though. Ok, interesting. I noticed that one of my Sepolia nodes that'd been running for awhile had 100GB more disk in use than one made from a recent backup of the chain. Unfortunately I didn't notice until after the old one was retired so I didn't have the actual instance any more so was just trying to think what might've led to the discrepancy. But actually ya it couldn't have been retained blobs anyways, since they would've been included in the backup. 🙂 oh the exception is possibly if you snapshot sync. There's no real point checking you can download blobs for blocks before the snapshot because they are by definition canonical anyway. Ya this wasn't a snapshot sync, rather our bespoke process where we stop the EL/CL on a node then backup it's local disk, then restore it on a new node. Anyways thanks for the clarification, good to know; I'll keep an eye to see if I notice it happening again (hopefully while the node is still available next time 🙂 )

excerpts.content: Could be wrong, but I'd expect it to sync them all "automatically" since a block within the retention period shouldn't be considered as a valid fork choice target unless the node actually has any blobs that go with it.  It may not download blobs from orphaned blocks though.
